query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN molecularWeight IS NULL OR molecularWeight = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_weight,
  SUM(CASE WHEN boilingPoint IS NULL OR boilingPoint = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_bp,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NULL OR family = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_family
FROM molecules;
